copy.title: Toplock Locksmiths — Our Branches & What We Do
copy.description: Toplock Locksmiths: door and window specialists in towns with doors worth caring about — St Albans, Farnham, Leamington Spa, Shoreham-by-Sea and more. Eight branches where the joinery matters as much as the lock.
copy.topbar: Locksmiths who treat the door as carefully as the lock
copy.eyebrow: Doors, Windows & the Locks They Deserve
copy.h1: Some doors deserve better than a drill
copy.lead: A Georgian front door in St Albans, a flint cottage in Farnham, a spa-town villa in Leamington, a Pennine terrace in Rochdale. Toplock's eight branches work in towns where the doors have history — and fit security that respects the joinery it goes into.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches, from Sussex shoreline to the edge of the Pennines.

about.heading: The craft position
body: Plenty of locksmiths can change a cylinder. Fewer can ease a swollen timber door so the mortice throws cleanly, re-hang a Victorian front door without splitting a stile, or fit a modern insurance-rated lock into period joinery without it looking like an afterthought. That's the work Toplock branches are built around.

It shapes everything: we carry chisels as well as pick guns, we quote for the door as a whole rather than the lock in isolation, and non-destructive methods are the default because destruction is expensive on a door you love. Modern uPVC and composite doors get the same care — a multipoint gearbox aligned properly lasts years longer than one forced into a dropped door.
There are {n} Toplock branches. Each one keeps its own local number and its own diary, so you deal with the locksmith who actually turns up.

services.heading: What a Toplock branch does
services.intro: Everything a locksmith should do — with the door-and-window work most locksmiths would rather not take on.
featured: Dropped, swollen, catching or draughty — timber eased and re-hung, uPVC and composite doors realigned.
Insurance-rated locks fitted into period and modern doors with the joinery left as it should be.
Sash stops, espagnolettes and casement locks — repaired sympathetically or replaced discreetly.
Sticking mortices and tired nightlatches brought back to smooth, before they fail outright.
Non-destructive entry first, always — especially on a door that can't be replaced from stock.
24/7 call-out across all eight towns when it can't wait for morning.
New keys for new chapters — moving in, letting out, or peace of mind.

cta.heading: Got a door that needs looking at?
cta.sub: Your local Toplock branch will quote for the door as a whole — lock, fit and finish.

copy.footerBlurb: Toplock Locksmiths — eight branches of door-and-window-minded locksmiths, caring for everything from Georgian townhouses to modern composites.
